EB05-014-P2.effect: 【登場時】從自己的卡組上面查看5張卡片，公開合計最多2張「梅加羅」或擁有《海王類》特徵的卡牌加入手牌。之後，將其餘卡片放到廢棄區。【啟動主要】可將這張角色卡置為休息狀態：使最多1張自己力量值6000以下擁有《海王類》特徵的角色卡，在這個回合中獲得【速攻】。
EB05-014-P2.effect_en:

[Activate: Main] You may rest this Character: Up to 1 of your {Neptunian} type Characters with 6000 power or less gains Rush during this turn.

EB05-006-P1.effect_en:
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may add 1 card from the top of your Life cards to your hand: Choose one:
• Give up to 1 Character +3000 power during this turn.
• Give up to 1 Character −4000 power during this turn.

EB05-021-P1.name: 亞爾麗塔
EB05-021-P1.effect: 【登場時】抽2張卡，並使最多1張自己手牌中費用8以下擁有《十字公會》特徵的角色卡登場。之後，這個回合中自己無法使角色卡登場。【攻擊時】使最多1張對手的角色卡，在這個回合中效果無效。
EB05-021-P1.effect_en:
[On Play] Draw 2 cards and play up to 1 {Cross Guild} type Character card with a cost of 8 or less from your hand. Then, you cannot play Character cards during this turn.
[When Attacking] Negate the effect of up to 1 of your opponent's Characters during this turn.

EB05-034-P1.name: 砂糖
EB05-034-P1.effect: 【登場時】【咚‼-2】若自己場上有7張以上的咚‼卡時，使最多1張對手的角色卡在這個回合中力量值-4000。
EB05-034-P1.effect_en: [On Play] DON!! −2: If you have 7 or more DON!! cards on your field, give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −4000 power during this turn.

EB05-052-P1.name: 嘉蘭

EB05-046-P1.name: 大和

若對手有原本力量值8000以上的角色卡時，這張角色卡獲得【防禦】，力量值+3000。
【對方攻擊時】可以廢棄1張自己的手牌：若自己廢棄區有10張以上卡片時，自己的領航卡原本的力量值，在這個回合變更成7000。
EB05-046-P1.effect_en:
If your opponent has a Character with a base power of 8000 or more, this Character gains [Blocker] and +3000 power.
[On Your Opponent's Attack] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If you have 10 or more cards in your trash, your Leader's base power becomes 7000 during this turn.

EB05-055-P1.name: 娜美
EB05-055-P1.effect: 【自己的回合中】【登場時】若自己的領航卡擁有〈知〉屬性時，將最多1張自己卡組上面的卡片加入生命值區上面。

EB05-055-P1.effect_en: [Your Turn] [On Play] If your Leader has the <Wisdom> attribute, add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.
EB05-055-P1.trigger_en: [Trigger] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If you have 2 or less Life cards, play this card.

EB05-016-P2.name: 妮可・羅賓

[On Play] Play up to 1 red Character card with a cost of 2 or less from your hand.

EB05-010-P2.effect: 【每回合1次】自己持有屬性（知）、且未持有【防禦】的角色卡遭到KO時，將最多1張自己卡組上面的卡片加入生命值區上面。【啟動主要】【每回合1次】將最多1張自己力量值6000以下、持有屬性（知）的角色卡置為活動狀態。
